","npc_borre_photo":"data:image/webp;base64,","npc_marloes":"data:image/webp;base64,","npc_coen_vos":"data:image/webp;base64,","npc_johanneke":"data:image/webp;base64,","marloes_desk_3":"data:image/webp;base64,","borre_dog":"data:image/webp;base64,","sem_8":"data:image/webp;base64,","npc_timo_reukema":"data:image/webp;base64,","npc_dirkjan_dokters":"data:image/webp;base64,","npc_sanne_lenferink":"data:image/webp;base64,","maarten_desk_3":"data:image/webp;base64,","marloes_desk_1":"data:image/webp;base64,"};</script>
<script>
/* CANTIQUE V10: echte lege locaties, losse geanimeerde personages, diepte en tafelmaskers.
   Foto's vormen uitsluitend het decor; nooit meer iemand twee keer in beeld. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const A=window.V10_ASSETS||{};
 const roomIDs=['cutting','borreoffice','meeting','folding','machine2','managers','jarno_sanne','marthijn'];
 const assetImage={};
 for(const [name,url] of Object.entries(A)){
   const image=new Image();image.decoding='async';image.src=url;assetImage[name]=image;
 }
 const get=(key)=>{const im=assetImage[key]||images[key];return im&&im.complete&&im.naturalWidth>0?im:null;};
 const draw=(key,x,y,w,h)=>{const im=get(key);if(im)ctx.drawImage(im,x,y,w,h);};
 const clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n));
 // Never use the damaged striped meeting_fg / folding_fg from previous builds.
 // Old duplicate staff overlays never enter the V10 scene renderer.
 const playerPrevious=drawPlayer;
 drawPlayer=function(t){
   if(!started || s.scene==='cabinet')return;
   const ix=(path.length? 1+Math.floor(walkTimer/120)%8 : 1);
   const im=get('sem_'+ix);
   if(!im){playerPrevious(t);return;}
   const h=clamp(270+(s.y-420)*.22,240,352),w=h*im.width/im.height;
   ctx.save(); ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
   // Shadow is contact-ground only; player's feet do not bob, rotate or teleport.
   ctx.fillStyle='rgba(9,16,22,.24)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(s.x,s.y-1,w*.28,7,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
   if(playerFlip<0){ctx.translate(s.x,s.y);ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(im,-w/2,-h,w,h);}
   else ctx.drawImage(im,s.x-w/2,s.y-h,w,h);
   ctx.restore();
 };
 function npc(key,x,groundY,height,t,opts={}){
   const im=get(key);if(!im)return;
   const w=height*im.width/im.height;
   const motion=(Math.sin((t+(opts.phase||0))/ (opts.rate||1200))* (opts.bob??1.4));
   ctx.save();ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
   if(!opts.noShadow){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(14,24,32,.18)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,groundY,w*.27,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
   if(opts.clip){ctx.beginPath();const c=opts.clip;ctx.rect(c[0],c[1],c[2],c[3]);ctx.clip();}
   if(opts.flip){ctx.translate(x,0);ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(im,-w/2,groundY-height+motion,w,height);}
   else ctx.drawImage(im,x-w/2,groundY-height+motion,w,height);
   ctx.restore();
 }
 function sprite(key,x,y,w,h,t=0){const im=get(key);if(im)ctx.drawImage(im,x,y+Math.sin(t/1500)*1.1,w,h);}
 const n=n=>!!(s.flags&&s.flags[n]);
 function layeredWorld(t){
   const sc=s.scene;
   ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
   draw('room_'+sc,0,0,W,H);
   const now=t||0;
   // Objects never become part of an NPC sprite; each drawing layer remains independent.
   switch(sc){
     case 'cutting':
       npc('npc_johanneke',868,590,205,now,{phase:410,bob:.8});
       // Sem lies on the snijtafel only during the completely fictional stage sketch.
       if(modal==='v4cutscene' && n('donorPledge')){
         const im=get('sem_1');if(im){ctx.save();ctx.translate(455,412);ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);ctx.drawImage(im,-145,-37,290,75);ctx.restore();}
       }
       break;
     case 'borreoffice':
       npc('marloes_desk_1',276,448,140,now,{clip:[195,309,152,117],noShadow:true,bob:.5});
       sprite('borre_dog',190,543,124,79,now);
       break;
     case 'meeting':
       // Only Erik sitting and Jarno on his knees UNDER the round meeting table.
       npc('npc_erik',181,535,224,now,{clip:[70,315,218,162],noShadow:true,phase:510});
       npc('jarno_kneeling',511,572,167,now,{noShadow:true,phase:0,bob:n('jarnoStartled')?2.8:.9});
       draw('meeting_foreground',0,0,W,H);
       break;
     case 'folding':
       // Jansje sits behind the white table, folding church papers.
       npc('npc_jansie_van_dijk',718,445,139,now,{clip:[630,294,168,106],noShadow:true,bob:.5});
       break;
     case 'machine2':
       npc('npc_johanneke',522,582,237,now,{phase:920});
       break;
     case 'managers':
       // Jarno is NEVER at these desks; he only appears in the meeting room.
       npc('npc_sanne_lenferink',547,435,127,now,{clip:[490,300,130,104],noShadow:true,bob:.45});
       npc('npc_carmen_'+((now%2850>2260 && now%2850<2550)?'wink':'van_den_berg'),830,657,239,now,{phase:850,bob:1});
       break;
     case 'jarno_sanne':
       // Panoramic empty production scene; this is a distinct room, not a duplicate of the desk photo.
       break;
     case 'marthijn':
       npc('npc_timo_reukema',280,546,230,now,{phase:600});
       break;
   }
   if(sc==='cutting'&&n('kidneyLost')&&!n('borreSwallowed'))sprite('kidney_prop',415,585,46,32,now);
   if(sc!=='cutting'||modal!=='v4cutscene')drawPlayer(now);
   if(hover||pending?.hot)drawGlowing(hover||pending.hot,now);
   // gentle vignette; never cover or distort part of the photographic scene
   const v=ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2,H/2,130,W/2,H/2,780);
   v.addColorStop(0,'rgba(4,8,12,0)');v.addColorStop(1,'rgba(4,8,12,.16)');ctx.fillStyle=v;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 }
 const oldWorld=drawWorld;
 drawWorld=function(t){if(roomIDs.includes(s.scene))return layeredWorld(t);return oldWorld(t);};
 // Correct labels & story availability to match what's physically on screen.
 if(scenes.managers){
  scenes.managers.spawn=[630,656];
  scenes.managers.name='Bureaus van Sanne en Carmen';
  scenes.managers.sub='Sanne werkt geconcentreerd; Carmen knipoogt geregeld. Jarno zit in de vergadering.';
  scenes.managers.hot=scenes.managers.hot.filter(h=>h.id!=='man_jar');
  for(const h of scenes.managers.hot){
    if(h.id==='man_san') {h.rect=[474,285,188,185];h.at=[662,535];}
    if(h.id==='man_car') {h.rect=[739,367,201,310];h.at=[742,632];}
    if(h.id==='man_meet'){h.label='Vergaderruimte (Erik en Jarno)';h.rect=[687,209,151,206];h.at=[776,567];}
  }
 }
 if(scenes.jarno_sanne){
  scenes.jarno_sanne.spawn=[825,644];
  scenes.jarno_sanne.name='Drukwerkstudio – panoramahoek';
  scenes.jarno_sanne.sub='Machines, voorraden en een lange snijtafel. Hier loopt niemand in de achtergrondfoto.';
  for(const h of scenes.jarno_sanne.hot){
    if(h.id==='js_jar'){h.label='Naar Jarno in de vergaderruimte';delete h.fn;h.door='meeting';}
    if(h.id==='js_san'){h.label='Terug naar Sanne en Carmen';delete h.fn;h.door='managers';}
  }
 }
 if(scenes.meeting){
  scenes.meeting.sub='Erik geniet van de rust. Jarno zit op zijn knieën onder de tafel.';
  scenes.meeting.npcs=[];
  scenes.meeting.hot=scenes.meeting.hot.filter(h=>h.id!=='meet_sanne');
  for(const h of scenes.meeting.hot){
    if(h.id==='meet_erik'){h.rect=[85,300,195,210];h.at=[312,570];}
    if(h.id==='meet_jarno'){h.rect=[398,405,215,224];h.at=[625,619];}
  }
 }
 if(scenes.folding){scenes.folding.spawn=[817,656];scenes.folding.sub='Jansje vouwt kerkbodes; haar sprite zit achter de echte tafel.';
   for(const h of scenes.folding.hot)if(h.id==='fold_jans'){h.rect=[619,268,181,194];h.at=[769,544];}
 }
 if(scenes.machine2){scenes.machine2.sub='De papiermachine en Johanneke zijn twee afzonderlijke beeldlagen.';
   for(const h of scenes.machine2.hot)if(h.id==='mach_jo'){h.rect=[430,300,185,300];h.at=[615,604];}
 }
 if(scenes.cutting){scenes.cutting.sub='De echte lange snijtafel; Sems kantoor-donorscène is een fictieve slapstickpuzzel.';}
 if(scenes.marthijn){scenes.marthijn.sub='Schoon kantoor en aparte Timo-sprite; de werkvloer blijft vrij.';}
 if(scenes.borreoffice){scenes.borreoffice.sub='Borre ligt onder Marloes’ tafel en reageert op Sem.';}
 window.__CANTIQUE_V10__={name:'Cantique V10',rooms:roomIDs,images:()=>Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(assetImage).map(([k,im])=>[k,im.naturalWidth])),getScene:()=>s.scene,player:()=>({x:s.x,y:s.y}),scene:(id)=>{if(!scenes[id])return false;travel(id);return true;}};
 console.info('Cantique V10 active: no damaged foreground PNG layers, no baked-in people for 8 remade scenes.');
})();

</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  document.title='SEM in Cantique — Mobiel V11';
  const q=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const touchTools=q('touchTools');
  if(!touchTools)return;
  const notebook=q('touchNotebook'), side=document.querySelector('.side');
  const panel=q('touchActions'), inspect=q('touchInspect'), inventory=q('touchInventory');
  let showActions=false, lastScene='';
  function noteOpen(val){side.classList.toggle('touchOpen',val);notebook.classList.toggle('active',val);notebook.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(val));}
  notebook.addEventListener('click',()=>noteOpen(!side.classList.contains('touchOpen')));
  side.querySelectorAll('.sideTabs button').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{noteOpen(true)}));
  inventory.addEventListener('click',()=>{noteOpen(false);const el=document.querySelector('.bottom'); el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});el.classList.toggle('activeTouch');});
  q('touchSound').addEventListener('click',()=>{q('soundBtn').click();q('touchSound').classList.toggle('active')});
  q('touchFullscreen').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
    noteOpen(false);
    const target=q('viewport');
    try { if(document.fullscreenElement){await document.exitFullscreen()} else if(target.requestFullscreen){await target.requestFullscreen()} else {target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});q('touchInfo').textContent='Tik op Deel → Zet op beginscherm voor een app op volledig scherm.';} }
    catch(e){target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});q('touchInfo').textContent='Draai horizontaal of kies Deel → Zet op beginscherm.';}
  });
  function nameOfHot(h){return String(h.label||'Voorwerp').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}
  function rebuildActions(){
    panel.replaceChildren(); if(!showActions)return;
    let arr=(scenes[s.scene]&&scenes[s.scene].hot)||[];
    const unique=new Set();
    arr.forEach(h=>{const label=nameOfHot(h);if(!label||unique.has(label))return;unique.add(label);
      const b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.textContent=label;
      b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!started||s.ending)return;noteOpen(false);panel.classList.remove('open');showActions=false;inspect.classList.remove('active');inspect.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'); if(dlg||modal)return;walkTo(...h.at,h);sound('tap');});
      panel.appendChild(b);
    });
    panel.classList.toggle('open',showActions);
  }
  inspect.addEventListener('click',()=>{showActions=!showActions;inspect.classList.toggle('active',showActions);inspect.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(showActions));rebuildActions();});
  // Increase thumb tolerance outside existing rectangles, without stealing floor taps.
  const baseHot=hotspotFound;
  hotspotFound=function(x,y){const exact=baseHot(x,y);if(exact||!matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches)return exact;
    if(inWalk(x,y))return null;
    const mobileWidth=Math.max(320, q('game').getBoundingClientRect().width);
    const halo=Math.min(36,Math.max(14, 12*960/mobileWidth));
    let choice=null,dist=Infinity;
    for(const h of scenes[s.scene].hot||[]){const [rx,ry,rw,rh]=h.rect;const dx=Math.max(rx-x,0,x-rx-rw),dy=Math.max(ry-y,0,y-ry-rh);const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<halo&&d<dist){choice=h;dist=d;}}
    return choice;
  };
  // Keep mobile actions synchronized with the actual room without modifying game logic.
  setInterval(()=>{if(s.scene!==lastScene){lastScene=s.scene;if(showActions)rebuildActions()}},450);
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',()=>{lastScene='';if(showActions)rebuildActions()});
  // Simple install / offline support only on HTTPS (as required by browsers).
  if('serviceWorker' in navigator && location.protocol==='https:') {
    window.addEventListener('load',()=>navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js').catch(()=>{}));
  }
})();
</script>
</body></html>
